text:
Priya Nair: Quick check — are we green to publish the CasePack for Solara this Friday (embargo until 10am PT)? Need final quote sign-off + legal clearance by EOD Thursday.
Ari Gomez: Working on the launch post copy, will fold in the new benchmark stat from Samir. ETA this afternoon.
Samir Patel: FYI the benchmark updated after the quantization tweak — new figure is 3.4x latency reduction vs baseline. I'll paste the blurb in a sec.
Ari Gomez: Sweet — once I have that I can shorten it for the hero line. Priya, are we bundling the webinar invite in the same email?
Priya Nair: Yes, webinar + on-demand recording in the same send. Webinar is Tue 2pm PT, link pending. Also need the 1-line customer quote and permission to use Solara logo.
Samir Patel: Quote candidate from the transcript: "Switching to Redwood cut our inference cost by ~60% while improving tail latency." Is that ok to use or do we need legal redaction?
Janelle Wu: Please send the raw transcript clip and the draft quote. Legal needs to confirm no product-performance comparative claims that imply competitor names. This one looks fine but I'll check with counsel.
Priya Nair: Uploaded transcript segment here: https://drive.redwood/solara/transcripts/clip-3.txt
Priya Nair: Also adding the publish checklist:
```
- Final hero copy (marketing)
- Short quote (customer sign-off)
- Legal approval (Janelle)
- Asset pack (logo, headshot, customer one-pager)
- Webinar link + embed
- SFDC campaign + UTM tags
- Press slack + blog post scheduling
```
Ari Gomez: Copy draft pasted:
> "With Redwood, Solara reduced inference cost and cut tail latency — we ship features faster and more reliably."
Would like a 1-line quote variant: "Redwood helped us cut inference costs and speed up releases."
Samir Patel: I pushed the benchmark callout:
> "3.4x median latency improvement at 95% production load after applying Redwood Optimize profiles."
Janelle Wu: Quick update — counsel says the customer quote is fine as-is but we need Solara to sign the short approval form. They also requested we remove the explicit 95% phrasing; prefer a generic latency improvement reference.
Priya Nair: Noted. Priya -> @Solara-CS pinged them for sign-off and form. Solara legal said they'd try for EOD Thursday.
OpsBot: Reminder: add SFDC campaign 'Solara_Casepack_Mar2026' and set UTM_campaign=solara_casepack to the email template.
Ari Gomez: Once Solara signs, I'll finalize hero and schedule blog + social for Friday 10am PT. Samir — can you confirm the small figure that appears in the hero (shortened version of benchmark)?
Samir Patel: Hero stat suggestion: "3x latency improvement" (rounded). OK from my side.
Janelle Wu: If customer signs before EOD, legal greenlights publish. If not, we delay until Monday.
Priya Nair: Great — I'll update the launch calendar and loop in Ops for SFDC routing. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
